name: Dinus Cross World
storyline:
Bagas awakens at Dian Nuswantoro University in Kedirya, but the campus he once knew is now wrapped in a gloomy and mysterious atmosphere. The people familiar to him feel strangely different, and the world around him appears distorted, as if he has stepped into another reality.

As he navigates the gloomy corridors of the campus, Bagas begins to realize that this place is no longer the same. Landmarks throughout Kedirya City have become corrupted, turning into tainted reflections of the real town. The world feels hauntingly silent, yet filled with unseen presences that watch his every move.

In his search for a way home, Bagas encounters ghosts that hunt him and inhabitants who seek his help to fulfill their final requests before accepting their fate. Each encounter reveals pieces of the path that may lead him back to his world.
summary: Experience the journey through beautiful pixel-art graphics, a hauntingly quiet atmosphere, and environments inspired by real Indonesian architecture. Discover Kedirya City as a reimagined reflection of a real-world town, and encounter spirits inspired by Indonesian folklore.
